name: Pendulum Heights
design_intent:
PENDULUM HEIGHTS — THE HIGH WIRE #14 (tier 3, thin ridge + ONE non-lethal ball). Two thin trampoline ridges over a deep dusk void split by a 620px gap, with two outboard spring perches at the far ends (560px gaps) and ONE swinging non-lethal pendulum sweeping the central gap lane. The circuit's first moving part: the ball never kills, it SHOVES a mistimed crosser toward the void, so the danger stays the fall (the High Wire identity) while adding a timing beat to the exposed crossing. kill_shape = void_is_floor. Signature: exposure + a rhythm layer, hazard-LIGHT (the ball is a shover, not a killer). Feel = 'cross the gap on the ball's clear beat, or get whipped off the wire into the deep.'

ENGINE: the moving_hazard pendulum (LevelLoader._build_moving_hazard) is a NON-lethal directional shove (<= 700px/s, no hitstun); the void is the killer. Reuses the shipped wrecking_yard primitive; no new code.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / spring 480; drift ~395 trampoline / ~527 spring MAX; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 620px in ~0.9s; super 2800 clears all). Left ridge x0..1000 top860; right ridge x1620..2620 top860; outer spring perches x-880..-600 (L) and x3220..3500 (R) top860; pendulum pivot (1310,320) arm 700 dipping into the gap lane:
- GAP left<->right ridge: 620px over the void, the pendulum's lane. 620 > 527 (max spring drift) and >> 395. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; launch on the ball's ~0.8s apex dwell (it hangs high and clear) or get shoved off mid-lane. Miss = fall into the deep void. Verb: FLY (+ TIME). (Rule A.)
- REACH the outer perches: ridge-end-to-perch = 560px over the void each side. > 527. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED both directions. Verb: FLY. (Rule A.)
- RECOVER: ridge bottom 916 -> bottom blast line 1866 = 950px of open sky (>= 650, Rule D) -> a shoved-but-fuelled player boosts back onto a wire (the shove is recoverable by construction); the outer perches sit only ~110px inside the side blast (a fast outer ring-out). Verb: FLY.
- The ball is a shover, never a stepping stone: every crossing (620/560px) exceeds the 527px max spring drift, so the jetpack is required to move at all; the pendulum only times/reshapes the boosted line. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing, not scenery.
